description.value: La Ruota Pizzeria is a Neapolitan-inspired pizza franchise with four Metro Vancouver locations, cooking its pies in a 900°F oven using authentic Caputo '00' flour and fresh ingredients sourced from Italy and BC. The West Broadway location sits on one of Vancouver's primary east-west cycling corridors and offers a broad menu spanning meat and veggie pizzas, sandwiches, pastas, and antipasti. The restaurant operates a franchise model with online ordering, delivery, and a loyalty rewards program.
